summary: Fix the dead detail page at its root: paper keys are URLs, the server read the still-encoded path segment so every lookup 404'd. /api/paper now takes ?key= (decoded by parse_qs) with an unquote()d path fallback, plus a regression test using a URL-shaped key. Adds 取消收藏 on cards, library rows and the detail toggle, and replaces the single palette with four selectable theme presets (mint/rose/sand/ink, none blue).
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit f4620e4. Server route + static UI + test; no model call.

budget_impact.rationale: Bug fix and presentation work only; no model call and no budget/config change.
budget_impact.before: Detail and library clicks silently 404'd; no way to un-save; one palette the owner disliked.
budget_impact.after: Detail opens via ?key= with a regression test; un-save available in three places; four theme presets with a header switcher.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.command: live detail via ?key= with a URL key

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; bug fix and UI, not recommendation quality

open_risks: Theme choice is subjective and unverified visually (no screenshot test).
Recommendation quality remains unproven; gates stay not_run.
Export, notes, Zotero import and Tauri packaging still missing.
